Customization hook for creating description out of defined values.

The Set is likely to contain only one element in most cases.

items.source: Common base for JsonSchemaObject with shared types and JsonSchemaObject.toDocument() implementation. Schema objects are immutable. Calling methods to configure properties creates a new object instance.
items.translation:
`JsonSchemaObject` 的通用基础类，包含共享类型以及 `JsonSchemaObject.toDocument()` 的实现。  
模式对象是不可变的；调用配置属性的方法会创建一个新的对象实例。
描述从接口复制：JsonSchemaObject

items.source: Create the JSON schema complying Document representation. This includes type, description and the fields of UntypedJsonSchemaObject.Restrictions.toDocument() if set.
items.translation: 创建符合Document表示法的 JSON 架构。这包括类型、描述以及UntypedJsonSchemaObject.Restrictions.toDocument()设置时的字段。
